page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes stand in a right-hand margin column, in italic. Running head at top with the page number 239 at top right. A catchword stands at the foot of the text, right.

main_text.p: Ipsa vero utitur qualitatibus ceu instrumentis (ut supra.)
Qualitatum illarum, pro intensionis & remissionis modo distincti quidam GRADUS sunt.
Hinc nonnullae in gradu primo, aliae in secundo, tertio, quarto dicuntur calidae, humidae, frigidae, siccae.+
Facultates porro hae consistunt vel in tota planta, vel in partibus ejus.
I. RADIX plantae vel alterat, vel purgat.De Plan-tarum Ra-dicibus
Alterat qualitate vel manifesta, vel occulta.
Quae cōservat aut prima aut secunda est.+
Prima qualitate alterantes radices calidae sunt, frigidae, humidae aut siccae.Radices alterantes prima qualitate
Idque in primo, secundo, tertio aut quarto gradu: Uti fere in reliquis etiam partibus.
Radices primo gradu calidae sunt, Altheae, Acanthi, Buglossae, Glycyrrhi-zae,&c.

page.notes: The printed "+" after several sentences appears to be a printer's mark; copied as printed. "cōservat" is read from printed "cöfervat", with the macron standing for the omitted n; the reading is uncertain. The catchword at the foot is partly cut off; "Sec in" is read with doubt. Show-through from the facing page (faint text at upper left and lower left) is left out. The running head is given as printed with the chapter number.
